description:
## Functional specifications and files
Add definition value_type/value_config/resources/assignment_type/threshold, typed persisted value, origin/state/version/metadata in one assignment store. Adapt existing domain operations/read consumers and transactional cleanup coherently; preserve existing installation data or fail safely with documented migration policy.
Files/owners: lib/zaq/ingestion/labels*, actions/*label*, document.ex, chunk.ex, label migration and label query projections.
## Tests to add before implementation
Extend catalog/resource/value/lifecycle suites and shared fixtures: Boolean false, scale zero/step/range, option membership, invalid config/in-use edits, pending/excluded distinctions, atomic bulk/stale writes, FK replacement cleanup and resource ID isolation. Property invariants; migration up/down/reapply.
## Branches/paths validated
Success, invalid input, nil/denied actor, stale/concurrent write, unavailable/deleted source, lifecycle cleanup and failure rollback where relevant. No hidden cross-service calls.
## Mocking plan
Real Repo, validated Actions, NodeRouter and domain boundaries. Mock only external provider/conversion HTTP when relevant; runtime dependencies via existing Zaq.Config opts, no global mutation.
## Documentation
Update owner module docs and relevant existing service/BO guide alongside behavior; durable evidence here. Follow docs/documentation.md.
## Action reuse assessment
Extend existing Actions/domain contexts; schema validation local to owning Labels domain. Reuse permission and transaction boundaries, no duplicated mutation implementation. Typed resource/version/edit inputs -> existing success/typed errors; automatic configuration has no model effects.
## Validation/dependencies
Read AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/code-quality.md and applicable service guides. Scoped tests + mix q only per implementation issue. Final precommit reserved for final child. Supervisor verifies before closure. New feature E2E remains zaq-kw0.15 -> zaq-kw0.16.

comments.text: Supervisor checkpoints: public definitions value_type/value_config/resources/assignment_type/threshold; native bool/number/option-id value; assigned/pending/excluded state distinct. Pending visible in chips/editor/key presence, concrete value filters assigned only. Single textual resource_id allows canonical folder identity, generated document/chunk FK columns retain cascades and indexed lookups. Chunk sequence must survive dynamic table reset to prevent stale ID reuse. Metadata preservation corrected with trusted editor ID. Interim compile and 3 additive existing-suite tests pass; migration mapping and old-test behavioral changes remain awaiting user input. No precommit.

Independent interim pr-review/adversarial review requests two fixes: (1) native scale max10^37/value=max-1/increment2 raises Decimal.Error under default precision34; exact grid validation must not depend on rounded Decimal context, add large precision regression/property. (2) unrelated definition edits unconditionally fetch all distinct assignment values under definition write lock; skip value validation unless type/config/mode changes, check only actually removed resources. Author fixing both; final approval withheld. Earlier 10^30 numeric hypothesis disproved. No test expectation or migration permission inferred.

Independent re-review approves interim foundation: both findings resolved, no new defect found. Reviewer reproduced original10^37 off-grid rejection and alternative negative10^80/decimal cases even with Decimal precision1, without app/DB startup. Definition-only edits now skip scans; resource removal/config/pending-mode validation retained. Author q and8 focused tests1property pass. This is NOT final PR approval or issue completion: legacy mapping and existing-suite behavioral conversion are still pending; source/folder/UI integration later.

User explicitly approved both test-contract migrations and legacy options mapping in latest conversation message Approved. Implement deterministic option IDs preserving exact normalized legacy text/display labels, explicit Unspecified for selected nil, preserve exclusions/versions/timestamps. No arbitrary Boolean/scale inference; no data discard. Migrate existing test suites/fixtures within approved scope, retain auth/concurrency/rollback coverage; extend and consolidate existing tests.

Foundation commit 0a3882374 passes 62 focused cases (8 properties) and mix q. Independent review in progress. Newly confirmed migration visibility issue: aggregating legacy private assignment text into globally readable definition options expands access. User asked explicitly whether preserve existing visibility or allow shared choices; pending decision, no migration deployment authorized by silence. Option-count concern disproved against current commit (no cap; 201-choice regression). Original-data migration clone evidence recorded by implementation agent.

User clarified existing labeling is not production-ready and does not require migrating old values into new tables. This supersedes prior lossless legacy assignment conversion approval. Remove old-value copying, deterministic legacy options, conversion preflight and lossless rollback machinery/tests. Use straightforward schema transition with new shared assignment storage; do not promote old private values into global definitions. Preserve unrelated documents/content/permissions. Typed contract tests remain; validate fresh schema and transition without elaborate legacy migration infrastructure. Pending visibility question is resolved by eliminating conversion, not by broadening permissions.

User-directed simplified transition: retain definition IDs/names/descriptions/revisions/timestamps and Document/Chunk applicability; initialize definitions as manual Boolean with empty config; discard old assignment tables/values/exclusions and create empty shared assignment store. Down creates empty old assignment tables and drops typed storage/config; no value translation or copy/restore metadata. Documents/content/permissions untouched. Obsolete lossless migration regression/helpers removed; fresh-schema and transition smoke replace them; typed/auth/lifecycle tests retained. Root accepted this scope based on latest explicit user clarification.

User 2026-11-12 superseded legacy-value migration: retain definition IDs, names, descriptions, revisions, timestamps and resource applicability; initialize standard manual Boolean definitions with empty config. Drop old document/chunk assignment rows, values and exclusions; create empty shared assignments. Structural rollback also restores empty old assignment tables and discards typed assignments/config. No old text becomes shared choices. Documents, content, source mappings and permissions remain intact. Removed only obsolete lossless-copy/rollback regression; transition and fresh/no-embedding smoke retain typed/auth/lifecycle coverage. No original dev DB writes.

Independent adversarial query review found two concrete gaps, reopening foundation for repair: numeric-equivalent pairs {label,1}/{label,1.0} survive Enum.uniq but JSONB compares equal, so label_match=all incorrectly returns no document; QueryResources agent schema description still promises removed trimmed/NFC/null value behavior. Native false/zero consumer paths were proven good. Source agent will repair in a separate isolated typed worktree, preserving native returned values and exact Boolean/option IDs and adding assertions to existing query tests. Temporary reproduction log /tmp/zaq-typed-review-probes.log; probe removed.

Root-approved narrow review fixes ready: AssignmentValue.equality_key/1 reuses decimal_parts and exact integer trailing-zero reduction for PostgreSQL/JSON numeric equality; Document normalizes duplicate label/value requirements with this comparison-only key and retains native payloads. No Action added: local pure value comparison extends existing AssignmentValue owner; existing query Action reused with generated native scalar/exact option ID/pending key-only guidance. Existing query/tool suites extended, no old scenario/assertion changed. Proved pre-fix regression, then 106 passing owner checks (5 properties,101 tests): document_test, labels/catalog_test, label_queries_test, query_resources_test. Includes PostgreSQL JSON equality evidence for signed zero, integral float/int, 10^100 and 2^53; distinct-number property under Decimal precision 1; Boolean/option identity and native payloads. mix q and git diff --check passed. Isolated query-fix branch/database; ACL fixture gate unchanged. Root authorized scoped commit; no precommit/push.
